summary: Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the shared venv. Not verified: mypy, black and isort are not installed in that venv, so type-check and formatting rules were checked by reading only (line lengths under 88 confirmed). Choices to review: an explicit non-Node guard raises SHACLPathError (spec said no separate check, but None would otherwise act as a wildcard in graph.value); the arg-type type-ignore sits on the parser call inside the pytest.raises block rather than the with-line, since the with-line calls nothing. Nothing was committed.
